groups.name: Volcanoes
groups.fact: Mount St. Helens' 1980 eruption was the deadliest and most economically destructive volcanic event in US history.

groups.name: Peaks of the Alps
groups.fact: Mont Blanc is the highest peak in the Alps, at about 4,806 m.

groups.name: Eight-thousanders (above 8,000 m)
groups.fact: There are exactly 14 peaks above 8,000 m, and all of them are in the Himalaya and Karakoram.

groups.name: Highest peak of a continent
groups.fact: Vinson Massif in Antarctica was first climbed only in 1966.
